description:
Aggregate real estate market statistics (count, average & median price USD, average & median price per sqm USD, min/max price, average area) grouped by district, renovation_status, construction_stage, rooms, seller_type, or complex.
<hints>
- Ideal for market analytics: comparing prices across city districts, or comparing 'black_frame' vs 'white_frame' vs 'renovated' vs 'off_plan' (katlavan).
- Supports all search_real_estate filters (city, deal_type, district, renovation_status, construction_stage, rooms, has_gas, etc.) to slice the market before grouping.
</hints>

exclude_orbi.description: Exclude Orbi City listings from stats

name: get_real_estate_stats
